items.summary: Forbidden Rites is a rerun of the action RPG's best league yet with some twists.

content.v: After the tremendous Return of the Ancients update to Path of Exile 2, it wouldn't take much to convince me to play more of it. The action RPG is the best it's ever been and finally feels ready to come out later this year. So when developer Grinding Gear Games says it's dropping a new mini-league next week to fill some time before release, you can bet I'll be there.

On September 4, the first PoE 2 event league, Forbidden Rites, will begin. It's not like the other major updates we've seen with tons of balance changes and a whole new league mechanic. Instead, developer Grinding Gear Games is keeping this one pretty simple with a small twist to the campaign and a big rework to one of the most divisive endgame activities.

Ritual altars will show up during the campaign that spawn waves of monsters and reward you with loot. Some of them will spawn bosses on top of other bosses and will let you pocket a powerful unique item if you can survive the gauntlet. This is actually something that could already happen in the endgame version of the mechanic, so I can vouch for how fun it is to have bosses like the gorilla wielding a stone pillar appear out of thin air to crush you.

I'm particularly thrilled with what GGG has done to the Trial of Chaos, the only thing in PoE 2 I actively avoided interacting with. Someone once described the Trial of Chaos as a mode where all you do is choose how you want to get kicked in the stomach. You kill monsters across multiple stages and pick deadly modifiers that only exist to make your life hell as you try to survive until the end. Some of the effects are quite nasty, like a 40% reduction to your defenses or bloody tendrils that hold you in place as every monster swarms you. Trust me, it's a nightmare.

In the new Trial of Chaos, those modifiers won't start out as painful as they do now, and they'll finally offer something in exchange for the agony by giving you a small boost to the quality of loot that drops. These, along with the other improvements to the speed at which doors open and new rounds begin, will hopefully make Trial of Chaos a tolerable—and maybe even fun—way to unlock your ascendancy class, PoE 2's version of subclasses.

Forbidden Rites will speed up the endgame progression so you can start exploring the endless world map earlier than you would in a normal league. There you'll find glowing green ravines torn through the earth that will host maps filled with Abyss monsters. And the previous league mechanic, Expedition, will now be a core part of the game if you like setting off explosions in the ground and mowing down whatever comes crawling out.

Sadly, the patch that will hit alongside the new league won't have the sweeping balance changes GGG had originally planned. Those will come with PoE 2's full 1.0 release on December 11—which seems like a risky move for a game with so many interlocking systems, but, hey, we'll see how it goes. That also means there won't be a whole lot of mystery in the endgame when it comes to the best builds and mapping strategies. If it works in the current patch, it's going to keep working in the next one, too.

Some people are so bummed about this they're going to skip the league. I'm just going to use it as an opportunity to try something I've never done before. All the new clips of the new duelist class look killer. Maybe it's time to finally put down the spells and try a melee character for a change so I can see what swords are all about when 1.0 hits.

items.title: 泄露的 DLSS 5 Mod 显示了 Nvidia 的 AI 过滤器会对您的游戏产生多大​​的干扰
items.summary: Nvidia 尚未宣布 DLSS 5 的发布日期，今年早些时候它的发布引起了广泛的反对

content.v: Nvidia 尚未宣布 DLSS 5 的发布日期，今年早些时候该技术的发布引起了广泛的反对。但最近的一次泄露让 PC 改装者能够在几乎所有游戏中注入神经渲染，这被用来展示其人工智能驱动的面部滤镜有多糟糕。

DLSS 5 的早期版本意外包含在 NBA 2K27 的构建中（通过 VideoCardz ），并由 RenoDX 模组社区访问并使用，他们很快开发了一个粗糙的工具集，允许任何人在各种游戏中使用该套件。这些测试包括对《控制》、《赛博朋克 2077》、《上古卷轴 5：天际》甚至《侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯》的广泛测试，每个测试都展示了 Nvidia 计划推出的严重依赖人工智能的后处理的一些优点和许多缺点。
Control 是最有趣的例子之一，因为它提供了硬币两面的良好外观。当打开时，主角杰西·法登的角色模型看起来确实更加细致，在皮肤表面获得更多的面部阴影和细节。但这也让她看起来与原来的模特截然不同，当你在一个以同样的方式增强不均匀的世界中航行时，她的动态更加突出。一些环境细节有明显的好处，尤其是一些已经开始老化的模型。但它在很多方面看起来都不自然，清楚地展示了轻微的瑕疵如何让整个场景感觉不连贯。

另一个有趣的例子是《侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯》，特别是因为这款游戏已经有很长的历史了。早在 DLSS 5 宣布时，Nvidia 就为这项技术辩护称，它只是增强了游戏中已有的几何形状，并没有从根本上改变它。考虑到这些例子，很难从表面上理解它的价值，但当看到它对 PlayStation 2 游戏的改变程度时，它就完全崩溃了。你很难找到任何人认为这是 Rockstar 经典作品的外观出众的版本，它对角色和环境模型进行了彻底的改变，但看起来却是错误的。

测试这个神经渲染套件的能力在其性能方面也令人大开眼界。使用 DLSS 5 的改装者已成功使其在各种 RTX 50 和 40 系列卡上运行，但总体而言，打开过滤器后性能会受到巨大影响。正如预期的那样，模型在本地运行以实时进行转换时会消耗大量 GPU VRAM，有时还会在此过程中将帧速率减半。这显然是一个不打算公开发布的早期版本，肯定会进一步优化。但它证实了最初披露的一些担忧，该技术在多个 RTX 5090 上运行。
Nvidia 在本周 Gamescom 期间发布了 DLSS 4.5，引入了下一代光线重建技术，以提高支持的光线追踪和路径追踪游戏的图像质量。 DLSS 5 预计将于 2026 年晚些时候推出，尽管自发布以来 Nvidia 尚未对其进行重大谈论。在最后的消息中，英伟达强调游戏开发者将完全控制后期处理效果以及它可以改变场景的程度，而一些开发者则公开反对它的存在。

items.titleEn: Leaked DLSS 5 Mod Shows Just How Much Nvidia’s AI Filter Can Mess With Your Games

items.title: NBA 2K27 迄今为止的评论
items.summary: 到目前为止，新功能使长期存在的问题成为人们关注的焦点。

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/nba-2k27-1787944622105.jpg

每年，《NBA 2K》系列就像我们最喜欢的 NBA 球队一样，都会做出足够的改进，给我们带来一线希望；一种新的信念，也许事情会比上次更好。尽管这种信念去年得到了回报，但迄今为止我玩《NBA 2K27》的 10 小时里情况却并非如此。虽然由于防守动作更加流畅和反应灵敏，场上比赛的感觉确实更好，但一些新功能（例如 MyCareer Eras）却恰恰相反。相反，它们就像放大镜一样，将焦点放在一直困扰本系列的问题上，例如对微交易的日益重视。这可能会将本应充满活力的篮球训练变成一项令人疲惫的审查练习。

让我们从好的方面开始吧：场上体验。进攻方面，虽然感觉基本相同，但有一些新技巧，使其比去年更具挑战性。对于初学者来说，节奏射击比 2K26 中的宽容度要低得多，因为你必须真正击中射击计的绿色部分才能进行跳投。全面披露：我虔诚地使用方形按钮进行拍摄，因为这是我自 2K10 以来一直在做的事情。通过这一变化，我变得更加偏爱经典的按住和释放方法，因为似乎没有动力去掌握节奏射击更挑剔的时机和上下运动。当然，也许有一天我需要真正深入研究后者，但今天不是那一天。
我对去年的《NBA 2K26》的评价

信念和失望是相辅相成的；只要问问任何一个体育迷就知道了。失败的沉重打击挥之不去，但最终被一种新的热情所取代——一丝希望，也许这一次事情会有所不同。近年来，《NBA 2K》系列的表现大多令人沮丧，因为我们常常以失望告终。值得庆幸的是，《NBA 2K26》凭借其令人惊叹的前奏故事情节，以“我的职业生涯”模式（就我的钱来说，每场年度比赛的明星和核心）逆势而上，成为多年来最好的模式。就像一群可靠的角色扮演者一样，进行了一些调整，最显着的是更新的射击计和玩家移动，将所有内容很好地结合在一起，以便每种模式下的游戏玩法压力更小，回报更多。当然，这些出色的改进使得缺陷更加突出，MyGM 继续像心怀不满的替补球员一样脱颖而出。总的来说，《NBA 2K26》相当于一支距离竞争只有几分之遥的球队，如果你不考虑所有在线模式中无尽的微交易，那么今年的口号“球压倒一切”就非常合适了。因为当你的核心球员表现得如此出色，并且所有人的目光都集中在球场上时，你就更容易忽视这些缺陷。 – Nicoe Vergara，2024 年 9 月 13 日
得分：8
阅读完整的《NBA 2K26》评论。
然后是新的基于逻辑的扣篮计，它不再像 2K26 中那样仅在您执行扣篮技巧时显示，现在每当您突破篮筐并尝试投篮时都会出现。一如既往，我们的目标是击中果岭，但事情并不总是那么简单，因为此功能考虑了防守者的站位。这意味着，即使你在比赛中获得了近乎完美的出手，但像扎克·伊迪或维克多·温班亚马这样身材高大、评价很高的后卫在适时的比赛中也可能会导致失误。
我承认，考虑到扣篮计确实需要一些时间来适应，这意味着我在尝试掌握它的过程中错过了很多扣篮。但在玩了几场比赛后，我开始欣赏 2K27 所带来的更大的现实感。尽管我希望每一次海报扣篮尝试都能进入，但即使是像扬尼斯这样强壮且手法可靠的球员也可以而且应该时不时地被塞进篮筐。
当然，这让我选择了让运球者慌乱、造成失误并赢得冠军的那一侧。如果说去年的防守是一名几乎没有上场时间的替补球员，那么今年他就是进步最快的球员。当我跳入一场比赛时，变化就立竿见影了。靠近防守球员并举手实际上改变了投篮！每个跳投者，甚至是有争议的跳投者，都感觉自己会进去的黑暗日子已经一去不复返了；现在球的双方已经平衡，打完整场比赛，至少在离线模式下，感觉比以往任何时候都好。
现在是时候前往 MyCareer 的领头羊了，体验其最新的单人游戏旅程，戏剧性地命名为《Fire and Concrete》。和往常一样，这个故事讲述了我们反复出现的英雄 MP，展示了他从卑微的高中出身一直到职业生涯的阶段性成长。不过，与前作不同的是，这本书非常精彩，共 11 章——而且越大越好，对吧？正确的？哦，如果这是真的就好了。
当我深入了解事情的本质时，一些缺陷立即显现出来，首先是故事本身。早期，一个关键的情节点是在一个动画小插曲中匆忙完成的，而不是在一个动作捕捉的过场动画中实际展开的，就好像这是一个商业广告，而不是一个决定职业生涯的事件。它闪得如此之快，以至于我几乎错过了它，让 MP 旅程的开始，可以说是最重要的部分，感觉像是事后的想法。
然后是国会议员本人，到目前为止，他还很难得到支持。就好像这个版本的他所有的个性都被吸走了，转而赋予了配角。也就是说，我仍然只处于故事的前半部分，所以随着故事的其余部分的展开，我们的主角最终可能会经历一些急需的个人成长。但现在，我宁愿扮演他有趣的表弟卡姆，由文斯·斯台普斯配音和动作表演，他在每个场景中都以他快速的俏皮话和机智的反击抢尽了风头。

作为一个叙事书呆子，你可能会认为我最大的挫败感在于《火与混凝土》平淡无奇的故事。嗯，事实并非如此。相反，到目前为止我最失望的是“我的职业生涯时代”，这是一种新模式，可以让你将一个创建的球员放入 NBA 的六个重要时期之一。听起来很令人兴奋，对吧？我的意思是，纸面上确实如此。但随后您意识到，创建多个自定义角色意味着每次都必须从微不足道的 60 分总体评分开始。因此，如果你想真正在这些时代中竞争，你必须要么在城市中进行大量疯狂的比赛，要么花真钱来立即提升你的角色。

您可能会问，“为什么不在 Eras 中使用升级后的《Fire and Concrete》播放器呢？”嗯，答案是我不能。一旦您在故事模式中启动保存文件，该玩家基本上就被锁定在现代时代。你也无法从一个时代切换到另一个时代，这意味着如果你想尝试所有的时代，你需要制作六个单独的角色。你现在看到我的问题了吗？我认为这是不可能的，但通过这种模式，开发商 Visual Concepts 以某种方式使微交易比以往任何时候都更加引人注目和令人讨厌。

items.titleEn: NBA 2K27 Review So Far

items.title: 平淡还是坏蛋？互联网对 GTA 6 的 Jason 的看法是分裂的，PC 玩家也是如此
items.summary: Everyone's got an opinion, including us.

others.title: Capcom Is Making Life-Sized Statues of Lady Dimitrescu and Albert Wesker, and the Internet Is Being Totally Normal About It

content.v: As expected, the GTA 6 Extended Look blew up the internet yesterday, and along with reactions to the huge open world , the missions we saw , and the features revealed in the 26-minute video, there's also been a lot of discussion about one element of the game in particular.
Jason.

While everyone seems to enjoy what they've seen of GTA 6's Lucia, especially her murking a guy with a high-heeled shoe and racking a shotgun with one hand, the internet seems a bit split when it comes to the other member of the playable duo.

After past memorable Rockstar characters like Niko, Michael, Franklin, Trevor, and of course John and Arthur from the Red Dead Redemption series, a lot of the reactions to Jason have been less than enthusiastic.
"I feel like half this [subreddit] could voice-act Jason better than whoever this is," one Reddit post is titled .
"The voice did not feel smooth at all and in my opinion the character felt very bland," kebualen19
Commented in another post that is simply titled " Jason's voice ."
"He seems heavily sedated," said Final-Tower6331.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/K54hnfbXcNkeQFr44JzviS.jpg
Our own website commenters, when they had something to say about Jason, weren't too keen on the lad.

PC Gamer commenter Cephelapoid said "I don't know the voice actor, and I don't mean to be rude, but it's a total miss for me. Very boring delivery, with little to no emotion. From what we heard it just seems like the character is incredibly dull."
Another commenter, GeraltOfButleria, wasn't a fan either: "Jason's voice actor was a bit of a mumblemouth, really weird choice."
And commenter Truzen: "I wish Jason was a little more flushed out in his [voice acting] as he feels so flat, as opposed to Lucia."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/BngP9Kz6o4g3nurmmSzKYf.jpg

Not everyone was so anti-Jason, however. In a Reddit post titled " I don't agree with the Jason criticism ," Low_Mouse_197 writes, "I see some people criticizing Jason as being monotone and kind of dull. To me he seems like an emotionally detached dude who has 'seen some shit' during his military service. It just seems like good characterization for a GTA protagonist… they aren't exactly supposed to be well adjusted individuals, so the fact he seems kind of 'cold' or 'simple' fits very well."
Many Reddit users also point out that this isn't the first time a Rockstar character initially appeared to be a bit boring in a trailer, but changed their minds once they'd played the full game.
"Makes me think of how people hated Arthur when they first saw him in the RDR2 trailers, look how that turned out," said YoursTruly2729.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/7Spdo7ERrgcDrmZjkoKSja.jpg

The PC Gamer team was a bit divided on Jason, too. I thought his character seemed a bit dull in the video and his voice is so distractingly deep that every time he talked I was reminded of Jame Gumb from Silence of the Lambs. "Put the f**king lotion in the basket!" I was left hoping Lucia could dump his ass and date someone else for the duration.
Tim said he liked Lucia but "Jason, on the other hand, felt very generic 2000s videogame dude, remarkable only for his startlingly deep voice. More time with him will hopefully reveal hidden depths."
On the other hand, in our work Slack, Lincoln revealed himself as a J-fan, saying he was "charmed by Jason's dope energy," adding "I like that he's just an archetypal Guy."
"If he's a Wife Guy he can stay, that's how you earn redemption for being Template Man," said Lauren.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/NvDKQpF5f45mKFZjbtZSQm.jpg
Tyler said Jason was growing on him, too, though "His personality is kinda at odds with the things he's doing in the game. He doesn't strike me as a backflip into the ocean kinda guy."
"I went to high school with so many dudes who presented as low energy plainfaced Present Individuals who would do a backflip off a dock in a second given an excuse," Lincoln said. "I know this man."

Ted didn't offer an opinion on Jason either way, but at least finds his relationship with Lucia convincing. "If nothing else, it was so real when Lucia asked which dress he preferred, she clearly disagreed with his pick, he went all 'then the other one I guess,' and she wound up wearing a completely different, third dress. Been there."
What do you think of Jason so far? I whipped up a quick poll so you can share your vote, and please feel free to elaborate more in the comments below.

items.title: Nodusfall 不是《Elden Ring》、《怪物猎人》或典型的 HoYoverse 游戏——它是非常不同的东西
items.summary: Hands-on with the free-to-play boss-killer.

content.v: Nodusfall has been Gamescom's biggest surprise: a new co-op action romp from the masters of gacha, HoYoverse, which seemingly does away with so much of what we all associate with the developer.

HoYoverse's games are normally vibrant anime affairs full of waifus and himbos waiting to be collected by thirsty players. Even as the genres and systems change from game to game, the studio has a distinct style and design philosophy—one that's been incredibly successful.

Instead of resting on its laurels, however, HoYoverse is taking a big swing with Nodusfall. One of the most fundamental changes is that characters are not obtained through random draws . This is not your typical gacha game. Indeed, HoYoverse hasn't confirmed any gacha mechanics yet—though we do know that cosmetic monetisation is being considered.

When it was first unveiled during Gamescom's Opening Night Live, the immediate comparisons being bandied around were Elden Ring and Monster Hunter, both of which are fair comparisons but which don't really tell the whole story. That they are inspirations seems undeniable, but Nodusfall is absolutely doing its own thing here.

First of all: Nodusfall is not remotely a soulslike. What it has in common with Elden Ring, then, is largely aesthetic and vibes. As HoYoverse describes it, the world of Nodusfall is one where "divine authority has crumbled and order has collapsed". It's simultaneously bleak and beautiful.

Monster Hunter is a closer relative. Solo adventurers and groups can select contracts, and then go out into the world to hunt down big beasties. These are lengthy, elaborate fights with multiple phases, taking place in spacious outdoor areas. So yeah, this all felt immediately evocative of Monster Hunter. But the similarities largely end there.

My four-player crew started off in a hub area, where we could select and customise our characters—one of which had two classes, while the rest had one. I opted for a serious looking lad with a big sword, serving as the group's tank. So you're not just creating a customisable blank slate who is defined by whatever weapon they happen to be holding.

Each character has dramatically different combat styles and unique mechanics, so while I was going to spend the next 30 minutes blocking damage with my huge weapon and sticking to foes like angry velcro, another member of the party was going to spend that same time hanging back and healing my reckless ass. Nodusfall isn't an RPG, but it does have an RPG's role-based classes.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/w5Mx5nXqcmrCuwBBDCEZvD.jpg

Our HoYoverse babysitter led us to our battles—three boss-style scraps with an escalating level of challenge, culminating in a massive brawl against a huge dragon and its giant, heavily-armoured rider. There wasn't much time for faffing in the open area, though I did clock other creatures ambling around—but we were here for larger prey.
It's more aggressive and spammy than Monster Hunter, but some precision is still required.

Even as a slow tank, I was surprisingly agile. Unless you've volunteered for healer duty, Nodusfall is a brisk, relentless kind of action game, where you'll be stringing together impressively flashy combos as you keep an eye on your skill cooldowns. And all the while, you'll feel like a human shaped missile, always launching yourself at whatever creature is in your sights.

It's more aggressive and spammy than Monster Hunter, but some precision is still required. I became rather fond of the clash mechanic, where you charge up a strong attack, and release it right as the monster is about to hit you, countering the attack. It helps that I looked stylish doing it, with my already massive sword growing, transforming into a magical, glowing WMD.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WnEDSNDDsmmMaLmPcpcDjD.jpg
I became a dervish of devastation, leaping around with my spinning attacks and filling the area with explosive magic.

When you're picking your character you can also select an ultimate, with the game letting you know which ones are a best fit for your role. I'm still very pleased with my choice, which transformed me into a towering, dual-wielding knight with a whole bunch of new—and extremely potent—skills. I became a dervish of devastation, leaping around with my spinning attacks and filling the area with explosive magic.

This was handy when the dragon and its rider split up, leaving us juggling two tricky foes—one airborne and one grounded. My ultimate whittled the rider down, then my team joined forces to deal out some divine retribution, summoning a huge ghostly warrior to absolutely pummel the knight. He still had a sliver of health, however, and used the last of his strength to consume his dragon. Now he was on his own, though, and we made short work of him.

Nodusfall's scraps are energetic, dramatic spectacles and I really appreciate the pure focus on the simple joy of whacking big monsters. I suspect the full game will be a lot more dense with systems—even if HoYoverse is trying something new, it's still HoYoverse—but it's got an extremely fun, straightforward core and a low barrier for entry. Got a free hour and some free pals? Go murder a dragon.
Nodusfall doesn't yet have a release date. On its official website , HoYoverse suggests following the official social channels for news about beta access.

items.title: Kick Streamer Neon Responds After Rockstar Seemingly Includes a Reference to Him in GTA 6 Netflix Showcase
items.summary: Prominent Kick streamer Neon has responded after Rockstar appeared to reference him in a side mission shown du

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/kick-streamer-neon-responds-gta-6-reference-1787945831744.jpg
Prominent Kick streamer Neon has responded after Rockstar appeared to reference him in a side mission shown during their special GTA 6 first-look trailer on Netflix.

Rockstar broke the internet yesterday when it premiered 26 minutes of gameplay footage from Grand Theft Auto 6 on Netflix, causing brief issues on the platform and even on Twitch, where a number of streamers were reacting to the showcase in real time.

Speaking of streamers, the highly-anticipated showcase featured a side mission where Lucia steals a car — only for a content creator to hop out of the trunk after the heist is finished, asking his viewers, “Holy sh*t chat, what do I do?”

Fans couldn’t help but notice a striking resemblance between the fictional influencer and a real-life streamer named Neon. The two boast similar features and even have the same style of haircut, prompting netizens to recreate that Leonardo DiCaprio meme as they watched the preview from home.

Neon went live on Kick the next day, where he officially addressed the topic — and while he didn’t provide any solid confirmation that he truly was the inspiration for GTA 6’s streamer character, he did thank his audience for getting him popular enough to make it a legitimate theory.

"We made it! We f**kin’ did it!” an excited Neon said as he sat in the back of a car. “Shout out to everyone in the chat. I've seen some reactions: A lot of people weren't the happiest, a lot of people were showing support.

“Two streamers did text me. You know who you are, and I appreciate you. Thank you guys. …Would a B-Tier streamer really be in [this game]? Nah, I’m just kidding. That is f**kin’ sick, bro! Streaming is really taking over the game. I'm just so happy and blessed and grateful to even be seen like that, in that way.”

N3on celebrates his alleged inclusion in GTA 6 "We f'in did it..shout out to everyone in the chat..I've seen some reactions, a lot of ppl weren't the happiest, a lot of ppl were showing support..2 streamers did text me..I appreciate u..streaming is really taking over the… pic.twitter.com/FOelAyJL2q
Later that same day, Neon recreated the scene beat for beat during a live stream in a moment that went viral on social media.
NEON recreated the streamer scene from the new GTA 6 trailer perfectly 😭 pic.twitter.com/XzVLur6Cwf

The streamer moment sparked a few big reactions from a handful of other popular broadcasters, with the likes of Kai Cenat, IShowSpeed, and Jynxi in disbelief that a content creator was included in the game.
“Wait, chat, they got streamers in the game?” a stunned IShowSpeed asked his viewers.
IShowSpeed couldn’t believe GTA 6 added streamers into the game pic.twitter.com/HDkPHoRLOH
“Is that a streamer?” Kai Cenat shouted, his jaw dropping to the floor.
Kai Cenat finds out a streamer is on GTA 6 pic.twitter.com/sT0w3XTBvY
“They have streamers. They’re adding streamers to GTA 6,” a shocked Jynxi said. “Oh my god, it’s a brainrot IRL streamer, too!”
Jynxzi was in shock after seeing Rockstar games add IRL streamers to GTA VI 🤯 pic.twitter.com/SXpLcEHkJC

Streamers are just one of the many real-life parallels featured in GTA 6. Check out our full coverage of the game right here on IGN, as well as a full list of all the side activities we spotted and 69 things we learned during our time at Rockstar HQ when we got a sneak peek at what’s in store come November 19.

Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze .

items.title: Rockstar 向 Netflix 寻求独家 GTA 6 加长版外观，而不是相反
items.summary: 侠盗猎车手 6 的大型扩展外观（大部分）顺利进行，显然，这是 Rockstar Ga

others.title: Watch GTA 6 Extended Look Here - 17 Things We've Learned

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/06/gtaonothumb-1786018055324.png
《侠盗猎车手 6》的大型扩展外观（大部分）进展顺利，显然，Rockstar Games 的想法首先是将其带到 Netflix，而不是相反。
在《GTA 6》受到空前的炒作的同时，粉丝们也感到相当困惑，他们质疑 Rockstar 在昨天首映后的六个小时内将其游戏首秀在 Netflix 上独占的决定。杰森和露西娅故事的第一次真实呈现确实让观众惊叹不已，但即使在《罪恶都市》看了 27 分钟之后，问题仍然存在：为什么选择 Netflix？
许多人认为这是这家流媒体巨头为了吸引眼球而炮制的一笔高价值交易，但显然事实并非如此。 Rockstar 公关代表在重大揭晓前告诉 Kindaunny Games，在 Netflix 上播放扩展版实际上是 GTA 6 开发者的想法。引用是：“我们想去 Netflix。”
这种回应可能会产生比答案更多的问题。 Rockstar 本月早些时候确认将《侠盗猎车手 6：扩展版》独家推出 Netflix 的计划首次引起了人们的关注，并承诺最终将推出期待已久的第三部预告片的长篇版本，但仅限订阅者。尽管知道完整演示最终将在几个小时后在 YouTube 上发布，但等待下一款侠盗猎车手 13 年的粉丝们还是很恼火，因为如果他们不想掏钱，就必须等待更长时间。
“这真是太卑鄙了，”X 上的一位粉丝当时说道。 “每个人都对《GTA 6》的加长版外观感到兴奋，但它首先在 Netflix 上首映，这将影响人们订阅。这一点需要指出，因为如果任何其他工作室，例如 Bethesda，这样做，他们就会被钉在十字架上。”
尽管如此，还是有一些人愿意耐心等待，看看 Rockstar 的宏伟计划是否还有更多内容。在母公司 Take-Two Interactive 的首席执行官施特劳斯·泽尔尼克 (Strauss Zelnick) 承诺，延长观看时间是值得提前入场的价格后，至少有些犹豫变成了兴奋。
他甚至表示，随着《GTA 6》的营销真正拉开序幕，该计划是“Rockstar 尝试新事物的一个例子”。他还告诉彭博社，“我认为当这部作品在 Netflix 上推出时，如果你观看它，你会了解更多。”
“如果你还不是 Netflix 的订阅者，那你绝对应该成为订阅者，”他当时告诉 IGN。 “至于预告片本身，它很快就会推出，我会让你得出自己的结论。”
好吧，预告片已经发布了，虽然它确实给人留下了深刻的印象，但目前还不清楚为什么 Rockstar 觉得有必要将《GTA 6: Extended Look》带到 Netflix。也就是说，距离发布还有几个月的时间。目前尚未透露开发商未来的营销计划，因此我们有可能在未来看到其他条目甚至剧集添加到扩展外观中。

不过，目前我们只知道 Rockstar 有它的理由。在昨天的游戏玩法揭晓之前，IGN 就对《GTA 6》的所有方面进行了早期的了解，并和其他人一样留下了深刻的印象。您可以在我们的预览中查看我们的想法，然后一定要看看我们在采访中要问开发人员什么。您还可以查看我们在参观 Rockstar 总部时了解到的 69 个细节、即将回归的 GTA 在线角色以及隐藏在扩展外观中的 Red Dead Redemption 2 复活节彩蛋。
Michael Cripe 是 IGN 的自由撰稿人。他因在 The Pitch、The Escapist 和 OnlySP 等网站上的工作而闻名。请务必在 Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) 和 Twitter (@MikeCripe) 上关注他。

items.title: PS Portal 优惠 42%，这是您在手持设备上玩 Grand Theft Auto 6 的唯一方式
items.summary: 忘记价格上涨吧。首先，GTA 6 将仅在 PlayStation 5 和 Xbox 上提供。

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/psportalgta6-1787942588804.jpg

Grand Theft Auto 6 将于 11 月推出，但仅适用于两个平台：PlayStation 5 和 Xbox。这意味着您将在相当长的一段时间内无法在手持游戏电脑或 Switch 2 便携式游戏机上玩它。如果您确实想在远离电视的舒适的床上或沙发上在移动设备上玩 Grand Theft Auto，唯一简单的方法是使用连接到 PS5 主机的 PlayStation Portal 幸运的是，现在有一种方法可以获得大幅折扣。
Xbox 玩家可以使用远程游戏对 Xbox Ally 进行同样的操作，但拥有这两种设备的成本更高。
PlayStation Portal（二手：非常好）售价 147 美元

Amazon Resale 刚刚将“二手：非常好”PS Portal 的价格降至 146.99 美元，因为在结账时会自动应用 30% 的折扣优惠券。考虑到几个月前索尼将 PS Portal 的零售价从 200 美元提高到 250 美元，这是一笔非常划算的交易。亚马逊转售是亚马逊二手商品的官方销售渠道。亚马逊表示，这款“非常好”的商品“看起来和功能都像新的一样。商品可能没有原包装。”您仍然可以获得 30 天的亚马逊退货政策，因此这比从 Facebook Marketplace 购买二手控制器要安全得多。
《侠盗猎车手 6》无疑将成为 2026 年最热门的游戏

GTA 6 的发布日期已确定为 11 月 19 日，我非常确信在接下来的几天内不会再有其他游戏在 PlayStation 或 Xbox 游戏机上玩。就在最近，我们自己的独家采访、Gamescom 2026 以及 Netflix 的独家加长版为该游戏带来了大量新内容。这款游戏将是 2026 年最大规模的游戏，如果一款游戏恰好是《侠盗猎车手 6》，那么仅仅购买一款游戏就完全值得购买 PlayStation Portal。

PS Portal 是索尼 PS5 游戏机的手持游戏配件，看起来非常像一个扩展的分离式 DualSense 控制器，中间有一个 8 英寸 1080p LCD 屏幕。它可以让您以高达 60 fps 的速度从控制台传输游戏，从而将您的 PS5 变成游戏掌上电脑。该控制器具有与 DualSense 相同的功能，包括触觉反馈、自适应触发器以及取代 DualSense 触摸板的触摸屏界面。即使您不在家里，门户网站也可以流式传输您的游戏，但需要注意的是您可以访问非常稳定、非常快的互联网连接。请记住，PS Portal 不是独立设备。这严格来说是 PlayStation 5 的远程播放器，因此您需要 PS5 才能使用它。

您不再需要 PS5 即可在 PS Portal 上玩游戏。现在，索尼不再局限于简单地将游戏从 500 美元的游戏机流式传输到 200 美元的掌上电脑，而是推出了一项功能，让用户可以直接从 PlayStation Now 云流媒体服务流式传输游戏。无需 PS5。门户网站所有者可以将门户网站连接到他们的 PS5 或直接连接到索尼的云服务器（以及 4 月份推出的一些新的生活质量测试版更新）。选择后者，您突然可以访问包含 120 多款游戏的游戏库，包括《对马岛之魂》、《生化危机 3 重制版》、《最后生还者第一部重制版》和《漫威蜘蛛侠：迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯》。值得注意的是，您必须是 PlayStation Plus 最高级别的订阅者，但每月 18 美元比为每款新游戏付费更具吸引力。
应该说，PlayStation Portal 并不是在家中通过 Wi-Fi 串流 PS5 游戏的唯一方式。您可以通过在移动设备（包括 Steam Deck 等其他游戏手持设备）上下载 PS Remote Play 应用程序来模仿其功能。也就是说，它的设置比较复杂，而且您会失去 DualSense 的一些功能。
Eric Song 是 IGN 商务经理，负责每天寻找最佳游戏和技术交易。当埃里克在工作中不为其他人寻找优惠时，他就会在空闲时间为自己寻找优惠。

items.title: 《神鬼寓言》开发者对推迟到 2027 年以避免“混乱窗口”感到高兴，我们都知道这意味着 GTA 6
items.summary: 微软的新《神鬼寓言》游戏原定于今年推出，但被推迟到 2027 年 2 月。

content.v: 微软的新《神鬼寓言》游戏原定于今年推出，但被推迟到 2027 年 2 月。该游戏总监拉尔夫·富尔顿 (Ralph Fulton) 在接受采访时表示，他对《神鬼寓言》的推出时间感到“非常好”，并补充说，推迟到 2027 年有助于该游戏避免原定时间范围 2026 年底的“混乱窗口”。
富尔顿在接受 IGN 采访时表示，推迟的原因“对每个人来说都很明显”。他表示，他“真的很期待”在 2026 年推出《神鬼寓言》，并表示他对 1 月份与团队再次举行全体会议并告诉他们“今年是我们推出《神鬼寓言》的一年”感到不高兴。但可惜，事情就是这样发生的。
“这样做的理由绝对合理。我很高兴我们避免了那个混乱的窗口，”他说。由于推迟到 2027 年 2 月，《神鬼寓言》避免了在《使命召唤：现代战争 4》（10 月 23 日）和《侠盗猎车手 6》（11 月 19 日）附近发布。
富尔顿在这次采访中没有提到《GTA 6》的名字，但他之前曾提到过。 6 月，富尔顿表示《神鬼寓言》推迟到 2027 年有助于《神鬼寓言》避免游戏发布的“真正拥挤时期”，并“显然避免了侠盗猎车手”。
“竞争少得多的窗口让我们有机会走出去，真正为自己创造一个时刻，我认为这场比赛值得关注，”他说。
本周，科隆游戏展上出现了《神鬼寓言》的游戏战斗镜头，看起来很粗糙，但 GameSpot 亲自体验这款游戏却讲述了一个不同的故事。
《神鬼寓言》将于 2027 年 2 月 23 日推出 Xbox Series X|S、PS5 和 PC 版。

items.titleEn: Fable Dev Happy About Delay To 2027 To Avoid “Chaotic Window,” And We All Know That Means GTA 6

items.title: GTA 6 看起来就像是这个热门电视节目中的公寓
items.summary: GTA 6 的故事发生在罪恶都市，这是迈阿密的替身，而且游戏似乎将以迈阿密 ap 为特色

content.v: 《GTA 6》的故事发生在罪恶都市，它是迈阿密的替身，游戏中的场景似乎是热门电视节目中的迈阿密公寓楼。
眼尖的粉丝们注意到电视剧《嗜血法医》中德克斯特·摩根在迈阿密的公寓似乎出现在《侠盗猎车手6》中。这部电视剧以迈阿密为背景，外景镜头是在迈阿密的海湾俱乐部公寓拍摄的。您可以在下面看到比较图片。
其他人指出，到《GTA 6》11 月发布时，《德克斯特复活》第二季就会播出。
有些人推测他们可能会发现一个看起来像德克斯特·摩根的人在罪恶都市中行走，或者游戏可能会讽刺这个角色或节目。这还有待观察，但 Rockstar 的 Rob Nelson 告诉 IGN，开发商正在“谨慎”地选择讽刺内容，以避免游戏给人留下过时的感觉。这就是为什么 GTA 6 不会讽刺美国总统唐纳德·特朗普或 COVID-19 大流行的部分原因。
GTA 6 将于 11 月 19 日在 PS5 和 Xbox Series X|S 上发布。今天我们对这款游戏有了更多了解，包括地图比 Red Dead Redemption 2 大 3 倍，以及游戏时长可达 80 小时。游戏还带回了六星通缉等级，你可以抚摸狗。

items.title: 玩《鬼武者：剑道》之前值得一看的 5 部武士电影
items.summary: While you were out partying, I was studying the blade (on DVD).

content.v: I wouldn't dream of telling you how to live your life, but if you're planning to play Onimusha: Way of the Sword on September 3, that gives you one weekend and approximately 120 waking hours to fill with samurai movies before the game's release. What else are you going to do— not watch so many classic Japanese films that you intuitively know how to walk the path of the blade the moment you pick up a controller as Miyamoto Musashi? Seems like a bad way to live to me.

But okay, benefit of the doubt: Maybe you're not planning to spend every second of the next week with your eyes peeled open going nuts on the Criterion Channel samurai tag because you have some appropriate gaming plans already established. Perfectly reasonable to devote the hours you could spend watching Akira Kurosawa's whole oeuvre to playing the remasters of the first two Onimusha games, Onimusha: Warlords and Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny , which are only about 3½ and 8½ hours long, respectively. You might even be able to rush through the first game more quickly than you could watch Seven Samurai!
Otherwise I can't think of any particularly good excuses. Job? Eh. Cooking? C'mon. Loved ones? The samurai code demands sacrifice for a greater purpose.

Assuming you're not yet ready to devote yourself wholly to such a singularly focused existence, here's a small selection of great samurai films you can watch between now and next Friday, each of which I think makes for a particularly good appetizer for Onimusha: Way of the Sword. Lemme tell you why.
Sword of the Stranger
Stream on : Crunchyroll | Buy on : Blu-ray

You're going to spend a lot of Onimusha parrying viciously fast sword swings, the likes of which have never been animated on film better than they are in Sword of the Stranger. This 2007 anime isn't as famous as it deserves to be: one of the best samurai films of the last 20 years, it throws a classic "wrong place, wrong time" ronin hero into a plot involving the emperor of the Chinese Ming dynasty. It's the rare jidaigeki flick to involve foreign characters—both the protagonist and his rival—while still feeling fully centered on the Japanese perspective. The Last Samurai it ain't.

Really, though, we're just here for the fights. Studio Bones, known for Cowboy Bebop: The Movie, My Hero Academia, and Mob Psycho 100, put in the work here. Despite the name on the video above, I promise there's even better in the full film.
Yojimbo
Stream on : Criterion Channel | Buy on : Blu-ray | Rent on : Prime Video , Apple TV

In Toshiro Mifune's definitive samurai performance, he stars as a cunning ronin playing two rival bands of criminals against each other in a small Japanese village. It's a classic plot, originating decades earlier in the American pulp crime novel Red Harvest and later remade as the spaghetti western A Fistful of Dollars, and it rocks in every single form.

The reason to watch Yojimbo specifically, though (other than it being one of the most acclaimed films by one of the most acclaimed directors of all time, nbd) is to see Mifune roll his shoulders, scratch his head, smirk, and furrow his brow. He does so much acting even when he's not saying a word, delivering a performance that conjures up a vivid character despite how little we know about him. I have no doubt Capcom pored over every microscopic detail of Yojimbo with Mifune in the frame while recreating his face and mannerisms for Way of the Sword.
The Sword of Doom
Stream on : Criterion Channel | Buy on : Blu-ray | Rent on : Prime Video , Apple TV

Noble, clever, fierce, brave; these are often the qualities of the heroes in samurai films, particularly the ones typically played by Mifune. Sometimes, instead, you get the coward or the trickster. Ryunosuke, in The Sword of Doom, is none of these things. He's evil incarnate, a psychopathic killer who murders his way through quite possibly the starkest, most nihilistic Japanese film of the 1960s.

Ryunosuke is not an anti-hero, but the cracked mirror image of an honorable samurai. To drive the point home, Mifune even shows up in a small role in Sword of Doom playing a wise, controlled master swordsman. The story here isn't about Musashi or his rival Sasaki Ganryu, but Ryunosuke has some spiritual similarities to Onimusha's depiction of Ganryu as a mad, jealous swordsman . Many films in this genre cover the same themes and emotional beats, but none of them look or feel like The Sword of Doom.
Ninja Scroll
Stream on : HiDive | Buy on : Blu-ray | Rent on : Prime Video , Apple TV

The Onimusha series dips into fantasy and sci-fi as it mixes Japanese folklore with stuff that must've started with someone at Capcom saying "this would be sick in a videogame"—like a magical gauntlet that sucks up demon souls to power up a famous samurai warrior. In Onimusha 2, samurai Jubei rides a robot horse and an ancient, magical machine-fish. That blend lends the game series a different flavor than the historical chanbara dramas that, melodramatic bits aside, tend to be fairly grounded.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2Kn5aKZXYqHGzJ2tgHxChA.png

The new game isn't Capcom's first crack at turning Musashi Miyamoto into an Onimusha: the publisher produced an eight episode Netflix series in 2023, also using Mifune's likeness. Clearly this revival has been in the works for a long time.

Iconic early '90s anime Ninja Scroll, on the other hand, is very much not grounded. It's graphic and at times outright nasty, but pretty much delivered the all-timer version of 'a hero with a mysterious past fighting through a roster of increasingly fucked up henchmen on his way to the big bad.'

We've got a guy who turns his body to stone, one who can melt into shadows, and another who can reattach his severed body parts—all classic videogame boss behavior. I'd be surprised if more than a handful of developers on Capcom's Onimusha team haven't seen Ninja Scroll. If you're splitting hairs I guess it's not really a samurai movie, but no samurai I'm aware of can transform into a demon demigod , so I think it's close enough.
This is the only film on the list you should maybe wait to watch: a new 4K restoration is debuting in theaters in October.
Samurai trilogy: Musashi Miyamoto, Duel at Ichijoji Temple, Duel at Ganryu Island
Stream on : HBO Max , Criterion Channel | Buy on : Blu-ray | Rent on: Prime Video , Apple TV

Okay, I couldn't stop at just five movies—I'm cheating a bit, but for this final entry I had to include Toshiro Mifune's Samurai trilogy, starting with Samurai I: Musashi Miyamoto. These 1954-1956 films come from early in Japan's post-war cinema revival (Godzilla and Seven Samurai were released in 1954 as well), and star Mifune playing the same character he plays in Onimusha: Way of the Sword, one of the country's most famous historical figures. There have been many, many adaptations of Musashi's life, but this is the one to watch for the broad strokes of his life, depicted in dreamy, vivid color and even more vivid melodrama.

Compared to the work Kurosawa was directing around the same time, they're not great films—the sword fights aren't very convincing and the intertwining romances and tragedies are as unnuanced as they come. Still, they're a perfect introduction to Musashi's story, with Mifune in the first film playing him as a wild, untameable ruffian before a Buddhist priest finally pushes him into learning the honorable ways of the samurai. In the second and third he's a markedly different person, pursuing stronger and stronger opponents before he reaches true enlightenment, choosing mercy over killing and honor over winning at all costs.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6offQUY4CXebir2TC27dMd.jpg

items.title: 《侠盗猎车手 6》已回归《侠盗猎车手 5》中的角色
items.summary: 《侠盗猎车手 6》将至少有一名来自 GTA 在线模式的角色。

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/27/mega-1-1787855222702.jpeg
《侠盗猎车手 6》将至少有一名来自 GTA 在线模式的角色。
在 Rockstar 对《GTA 6》的扩展中，粉丝们认识了一群道德各异的角色。粉丝们可能忽视的一个角色是瓦伦蒂娜（Valentina），她是去年在 GTA 在线模式中首次亮相的女性。她在 Money Fronts 更新的过场动画中首次亮相，可以看到她跳下私人飞机并与费伯先生互动。虽然她的角色当时看起来并不特别重要，但看起来她将在 GTA 6 中扮演更重要的角色。
该角色雇佣杰森和露西娅为一位正在参加聚会的贵宾担任保安，而聚会不可避免地会被持枪暴徒扰乱。目前尚不清楚瓦伦蒂娜是否会在此次任务之外在《侠盗猎车手 6》中扮演更重要的角色，但如果她这样做也不足为奇。这也引发了一个问题：这些年来，Rockstar 还在 GTA 在线模式中植入了哪些内容或哪些人。当然，粉丝们希望看到迈克尔、富兰克林和特雷弗在《GTA 6》中回归，但这是否真的会发生还有待观察。
瓦伦蒂娜是第一个确认在 GTA 6 中回归的 GTA 在线角色。#GTAVI pic.twitter.com/CbzzQAudDF
GTA 5 和 GTA Online 中包含了 GTA 4 中的一些角色，包括 Brucie、Karen、Packie 等。如果 Rockstar 继续采用同样的策略，我们也能在《GTA 6》中看到前作中的小配角，也就不足为奇了。在发布之前，我们可能无法得到明确的答案，但这一小透露肯定会引发广泛的猜测。
在相关新闻中，IGN 在扩展版之后还有大量其他与 GTA 6 相关的新闻。我们获得了游戏的独家预览、对 Rockstar North 联合工作室负责人 Rob Nelson 的采访，以及对游戏各种系统和细节的各种细分。 Rockstar 还证实，《GTA 6》的通关时间可以长达 80 小时，甚至更长，因此当游戏在 11 月发布时，你可能会在《列奥尼达》中度过大量的时间。
Cade Onder 是 IGN 新闻团队的自由撰稿人。他涵盖所有娱乐领域，包括游戏、电影等。您可以在 Twitter 上找到他：@Cade_Onder。

items.title: 卡普空正在制作迪米特雷斯库女士和阿尔伯特威斯克真人大小的雕像，互联网上对此完全正常
items.summary: Capcom 正在为《生化危机》30 周年纪念展让饥渴的粉丝梦想成真，并透露

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/capcom-reveals-life-sized-statues-of-albert-wesker-and-lady-dimitrescu-coming-to-shibuya-exhibition-1787938611600.jpg
卡普空正在为《生化危机》30 周年纪念展览让饥渴的粉丝梦想成真，并透露它将展示迪米特雷斯库女士和阿尔伯特威斯克的真人大小雕像。
在 Capcom 的 RE 周年盛典上，每个人都能找到适合自己的活动。该展览将于 10 月 30 日至 12 月 24 日在涩谷 BEAM 画廊举行，展览将以著名恐怖游戏系列中的标志性物品和生物的现实再现为特色，其中包括“精心制作的真人大小的恶棍模型”，据 SaigaNAK 介绍。
其中两个恶棍已经被揭露，互联网上的反应也没有令人失望。
正如展览官方网站 8 月下旬发布的那样，《生化危机》反派阿尔伯特·威斯克和村庄里的迪米特雷斯库夫人将在涩谷展览中获得真人大小的雕像。这些雕塑的概念艺术也被分享，展示了 Lady D 坐在华丽的毛绒椅子上，而威斯克则高高地站着，戴着他标志性的太阳镜和风衣组合。
看来这两个恶棍都将出现在展览的“恐怖证据”部分；据报道，威斯克被放置在“寄生虫和生物威胁”区域，而迪米特雷斯库女士则被放置在“真菌和幻觉区域”。
更重要的是，据报道，Lady D 的雕像高 290 厘米（约九英尺半）——不过考虑到她是坐着的，目前还不清楚这是否是雕塑的真实高度。
当然，互联网不浪费时间告诉全世界他们即将抢劫这些雕像。
“他们最好把它放在防弹玻璃里，”一位用户在 X 上拿迪米特雷斯库的雕像开玩笑。另一位用户只是发布了一张来自《国家宝藏》的 GIF，显示尼克·凯奇说出了他的标志性台词：“我要偷走《独立宣言》。”
另一位评论道：“如果属实，他们将需要‘全天候保护那东西，因为我知道很多人会试图对其进行抢劫。’”
我在《生物危害世界》30 周年纪念展览上看到真人大小的阿尔西娜·迪米特雷斯库雕像 https://t.co/JZ1JWNW0KJ pic.twitter.com/hMW249Zrtb
因此，在日本的生化危机探险中，将会有一座真人大小的迪米特雷斯库母亲雕像。 pic.twitter.com/aJIBXoPryq
https://t.co/ahpQ9hL6mv pic.twitter.com/dfzaBOywuA
不知何故，这些回复并不像有关莱昂·肯尼迪真人大小的雕像的评论那么奇怪，该雕像也将在涩谷展览中展出。 （你可以想象当本月早些时候宣布这一消息时，情况会如何。我们担心 Capcom 将合理地需要该特定雕塑的 24/7 安全保障。）
与此同时，粉丝们可以通过查看我们对扎克·克雷格（Zach Cregger）的采访来了解《生化危机》，了解他即将上映的改编自该系列的电影，该电影将于下个月上映。
Virginia（她/她）是 IGN 的新闻编辑。她拥有十年的游戏和娱乐报道经验，在格斗游戏社区、影响者新闻和病毒式在线趋势方面拥有丰富的背景。在 Twitter 上找到她：@TheeMissGlaze。

items.title: 回合制战术游戏粉丝突然吃得很好
items.summary: 《XCOM》系列实际上已经停摆多年，而 AAA 级回合制战术游戏已经

content.v: 《XCOM》系列实际上已经停摆很多年了，AAA 级回合制战术游戏最近也很难再出现了。然而，随着本周《星球大战零号公司》的推出，这种情况正在发生变化。它实际上是经典 XCOM 游戏玩法和克隆人战争时代的星球大战故事讲述的结合，在开始游戏的几分钟内，我就得到了与第一次玩 XCOM 游戏时一样的兴奋感。
通常情况下，我会尝试尽可能多地享受这样的回合制战术体验，因为我知道至少要过几年才能再次出现类似的情况。我记得玩过的最后一款 XCOM 风格的回合制战术游戏是《Classified: France '44》，该游戏于两年多前发布。我非常喜欢它，以至于我考虑重新开始它，因为当时还没有其他类似的东西发布。
但不再是了！作为科隆游戏展开幕夜现场的一部分，育碧发布了《彩虹六号：战术版》。 《Rainbow 6 Tactics》摒弃了该系列著名的第一人称射击游戏玩法，提供单人战术体验，玩法类似于《彩虹六号：围攻》的回合制版本。你使用无人机侦察敌人的位置，然后发动攻击，突破墙壁并精确而有力地击倒敌人。
它利用了《彩虹六号：围攻》著名的可破坏环境，但它完全包裹在一个完全不同的类型中。与《零连》一样，《彩虹六号：战术版》除了 PC 版外，还将在 Xbox 和 PS5 上推出，从而在 2027 年推出时拥有广泛的受众。
即使您没有 Xbox、PS5 或 PC，您仍然可以享受到最近的乐趣。当然，它也是一款角色扮演游戏，但《火焰纹章：财富的编织》肯定会满足回合制策略游戏的需求。开发者智能系统可以说是该类型的王者，根据我们对游戏的实际预览，它看起来绝对充满了内容。有四个主角，每个人都有自己的故事，所以这可能是你玩几周甚至几个月的游戏——希望时间足够《彩虹六号：战术版》推出。
耐心等待下一款类似《幽浮》或《火焰之纹章》的游戏发布，过去感觉像是徒劳的，但我现在对类似但不是真正的国际象棋游戏的未来感到非常兴奋。如果其他人也有同样的感觉，我们只需要出现并购买它们，这样该类型就可以继续蓬勃发展……也许还可以说服 Take-Two 为 XCOM 3 开绿灯。好吗？

items.title: [更新] EA Motive 在社交媒体上传播游戏预告片后确认《钢铁侠》游戏泄露
items.summary: Gameplay footage from what appears to be EA Motive Studio's Iron Man game has leaked online.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/ea-motive-iron-man-game-leak-1787936702334.png
UPDATE AUGUST 28, 2026: EA has confirmed the Iron Man game leak is real, teasing that it has "a lot more to show" in the future.

The publisher confirmed Motive Studio's Iron Man game leaked online today in a statement sent to Kotaku . It also directed viewers to a new X/Twitter account created in the aftermath of the leak. You can see its first post below.
"Well, that didn't go as planned," EA's post said. "But now you know, and we've got a lot more to show you. See you when we're ready."
Well, that didn't go as planned. But now you know, and we've got a lot more to show you. See you when we’re ready. pic.twitter.com/tU4TtUoZYZ
ORIGINAL STORY: Gameplay footage from what appears to be EA Motive Studio's Iron Man game has leaked online.

Video for what seems to be EA's long-in-development Iron Man game started circulating on social media today. It's a bit more than a few cobbled-together clips, too, showing a (very unfinished) project that features not only Tony Stark's Iron Man, but what seem to be a S.H.I.E.L.D. helicarrier and potentially other characters that Marvel fans may recognize.

The footage, which appeaers to be part of a trailer from an early-in-development build, looks like the kind of thing you'd expect from an Iron Man game. Tony can be seen flying under bridges and through city streets, beating up armored bad guys in between shots of him tinkering on new suit technology, giving the impression that EA Motive is crafting something that will have players traveling around the world.

The allegedly leaked footage for the Iron Man game promises that players will be shooting missiles, using arm-mounted lasers, and throwing missiles at tanks. We won't share any of that here, but if the footage does turn out to be real, it would seem rumors that Motive's Iron Man game was canceled have been greatly exaggerated.

Interestingly, this isn't even the first time this week footage for an unfinished Iron Man game found its way on the net. Monday, video for what seemed to be Avalanche Studios' Iron Man game also surfaced online . It's a different project that was rumored to be in development in the early 2010s before its eventual cancellation. While that team's vision will never see the light of day, nothing is suggesting EA's Iron Man will meet the same fate.

Motive officially revealed its take on the character almost exactly four years ago in 2022. Despite the immense amount of hype the Dead Space remake and Star Wars: Squadrons developer managed to generate at the time, things have been distressingly quiet since.

Our last real update arrived in April 2024, when the team reassured fans that its Iron Man game remained an "important priority" as EA brought it in to work on Battlefield 6. With little else besides a teaser image to keep fans occupied, some had started to worry the team's Marvel project may have kicked the can. However, for now, the game is still officially considered to very much be in development.

"In parallel, development continues to move forward on our Iron Man project, led by Olivier Proulx (Executive Producer) and Ian Frazier (Creative Director)," Motive general manager Patrick Klaus said in 2024. "The team made excellent progress this year, hitting a major internal milestone and laying a robust foundation for the journey ahead. Iron Man is an important priority for Motive, and I’m very proud of the work we’ve accomplished so far."

While it's unclear when footage from today's supposed leak would have been captured, it suggests Motive has been steadily moving along behind the scenes. In an environment where fans clamor for Spider-Man and Wolverine video games, an Iron Man game could (hopefully) have a lot of potential. EA had no comment to share when contacted by IGN.

While we wait for updates as Motive hammers away at its Iron Man game, you can check out the Tony Stark-themed popcorn buckets revealed for the upcoming Avengers: Endgame re-release . You can also check out our review of the VR game that released in 2020 .

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

content.v: 在《侠盗猎车手 VI》的全新长镜头预告片展示了超过 25 分钟的新镜头后，您可能会期待人们谈论视觉效果、灯光、动作序列或枪战。但 Rockstar 在 YouTube 上上传的该视频的热门评论比预期更多地涉及人类状况。事实上，有很多关于死亡和纪念的讨论。
最上面的评论（在发布时）指出：“为未能来到这里的人们默哀片刻。”与此同时，另一个人写道：“目标：活到发布日。”对 GTA 6 的等待已经很长时间了，尤其是自从 GTA 5 最初发布近 13 年后。
自《GTA 5》问世以来，不仅整个游戏行业发生了很多变化，人们的个人生活也发生了变化。例如，另一个人输入：“兄弟，我读完了初中、高中和大学……现在我需要为此请假。”悲剧显然打击了其他人，但并没有浇灭他们的精神，正如这条评论所见：“我在二月份遭遇了一场交通事故，失去了一条腿，但我仍然有我的两只该死的手和我的眼睛，宝贝！”
新的《GTA 6》预告片中有很多值得一看的地方，例如 NPC 会注意到您是否在游戏中公开携带武器。此外，这次偷车可能会更复杂一些。对于较旧的车辆，您仍然可以砸碎玻璃，但较新的车型显然需要钥匙克隆器。
《GTA 6》最终定于 11 月 19 日在 PS5 和 Xbox Series X|S 上发布。听起来这款开放世界游戏的通关时间可能约为 80 小时，因此请在这个假期做好相应的计划。

items.summary: Rolling deep.

content.v: Florida is a vast and wonderful menagerie. It is home to over a billion species (I didn't research that claim and nor should you), ranging from alligators to snakes to… alligators. Grand Theft Auto 6, I must assume, will be basically like a trip to the zoo with gun crime.

GTA 5, though? It does its best, but the animal quotient is low. In fairness, Los Santos, like its real-life counterpart, was not built to sustain life. But like so many things, this can be rectified through mods.

I have installed DogDog (it's about dogs), which is both a fan-made modification of the videogame Grand Theft Auto 5, and the source of history's most perfect English sentence: "You can summon your favorite dogs in any quantity you desire."

But it undersells itself. DogDog allows you to summon dogs(dogs), yes, but not just them. In addition to a small legion of loyal canines, you can also manifest cats, cows, lions, and—the following is based on the verified personal experience of this reporter— at minimum one chimpanzee.

Combo this dizzy-making new power with one of our previously installed mods, 2gether, and you can patrol the roadways of Los Santos with the entire cast of Homeward Bound at your back while a partying great ape sits on your back like you are a majestic and powerful steed. Which you are. Believe in yourself.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/u3WuiNpKsXNrYjBkN2aAiK.gif

One issue with this—and sorry to be a bummer—is that, yes, there are still gang wars happening and flying cars loose from the surly bonds of Earth. So sometimes, ah, well, look: sometimes bad things happen to the animals. You have to try to walk them out in nature. It's where they belong, I suppose.

items.title: 我尝试了任务管理器的续集，它有太多特效
items.summary: If Task Manager is so good, why isn't there a Task Manager 2?

others.title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy's Game Director and Star on Why Sophia Is So Special and Why This Prequel Let the Team 'Get Some Fresh Air' | gamescom 2026

content.v: The original Task Manager (that program you only ever open when something has gone wrong in your rig) originally launched way back in 1995. Now, 31 years later, its creator has put out a follow-up. About time, I know.

Dave Plummer, former Microsoft Engineer turned YouTuber turned guy who really wants you to know he made Task Manager, has just released Task Manager OG , and it works on Windows, Linux, and Mac. Plummer says he wrote a 107-page spec, fed it to Claude, and then partly vibe-coded this new program while his kid was getting surgery.

"By the time he was out of the hospital, I had a rough app working. But then he started bleeding internally, needed emergency surgery and a blood transfusion. Happy to say he's all better now—but suffice to say I had the rest of the week to tinker as he healed."

Now, with much better hardware than users had back in the '90s, Plummer wanted a Task Manager that would "push the limits." The sequel software animates at 60 Hz and provides data like mouse tracking and a summary page. It is also, by default, covered in neon and very high contrast, which Plummer says, "My autism leads me to embrace."
My first thought upon downloading it was 'damn, this is really ugly'. My second thought was 'this app does not need visual bloom'. Good start then?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UqNzTBvaANbXtg7dmHtVA.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/GBJkymdxBbrRTjTqs9EpXg.jpg

On top of that, the reading in Task Manager and Task Manager OG are simply different. My Chrome tabs came in at close to 11 GB on TMOG and just above 8 GB on Task Manager. Slack registered 1 GB on TMOG and 500 MB on Task Manager. These are pretty significantly different readings. Interestingly, both Task Manager and TMOG gave the same overall memory usage stats. Task Manager said 68%, and TMOG said 21.7 GB, which is around 68% of the 32 GB in my rig.

By default, Task Manager OG hogs up slightly more resources than the Task Manager pre-installed on my machine (around 120 Mb of memory versus 105 MB, and 3-4% of CPU usage versus just under 1%), but turning off high-frequency visuals does cut the CPU usage down to around 2-3% for me. That means, either way, TMOG is more intensive than Task Manager. To be fair, Plummer does say as such in his announcement, though the irony isn't lost on me that one would replace Task Manager with something that hogs more resources.

I then went into the performance tab, which shows your CPU, memory, and GPU running, alongside your internet. TMOG has added CPU power and thermals modules, which Task Manager doesn't. But CPU power failed to show CPU power and thermals gave a consistent 16.9°C (62.42°F ), but fails to say what is being measured. That temperature is lower than the room the PC is in, so it's likely not actually reading anything.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/TmDhs3LXa57qNQvAeb6RuX.jpg
HWinfo was capable of grabbing CPU power readings and all kinds of temps, so it seems unlikely the issue is a hardware one here.

The CPU performance tab does have tracking on different cores, plus clock speed, which is a level of default granularity I like, but also something available Task Manager by simply right-clicking on CPU and then hitting "Logical Processors."

Though I'm not a fan of the TMOG look in its default mode, you can change colours and bloom—that done, I actually quite like the layout. I can understand why a power user might want access to CPU, GPU, and memory performance on one page, alongside thermals and power usage. As well as that, the CPU overview has a neat function where the start of the graph is measured in seconds and the end of the graph in much longer intervals. This means you can get a second-by-second readout, but also a decent long-term one on the same graph.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/PDqv7caYYKd6NYhG5FfdeF.jpg

As of right now, a lot of the app's most unique features are only available to those who have the paid pro version, but you can't actually get pro yet, as the software is still in beta. Pro gets you a large HWinfo-style readout of power and frequency over your whole computer, plus a readout of installed apps, a layout of connected apps alongside their versions and estimated size, plus a disk space reader. There's also a set of benchmarks.

But alas, you can get pretty much everything here from a combination of Task Manager and the likes of Hardware Info. Mac has its own version of Task Manager too, and Linux has the likes of Htop and NVTOP to do the same job. TMOG seems to be more about convenience rather than offering something other apps can't, and of course there's that funky colour scheme too. There's part of me that wants to cynically point at the whole 'vibe coding' thing and say 'well, could have guessed that', but also this is a beta program that admits to being a beta program. Mistakes and errors are to be expected.

One thing I do like about TMOG is that, looking at Plummer's Twitter, they do seem to respond positively to feedback and want to implement changes based on what users like. That's certainly a boon, and something Microsoft gets a lot of flak for with its own apps.
Whether or not the pro mode will be worth the money is anyone's guess, but you can't buy it yet even if you wanted to. All I can say is I'm good with plain 'ol Task Manager and HWinfo for now.

items.title: GTA 6 让你向人扔狗屎
items.summary: 关于 GTA 6 的一条非常重要的消息曝光了：你可以捡起狗屎并把它扔到人身上

content.v: 关于 GTA 6 的一条非常重要的消息曝光了：在即将推出的开放世界犯罪游戏中，你可以捡起狗屎并将其扔向人们。
YouTuber TGG 参观了 Rockstar North 的办公室并与团队进行了交谈，他了解到的一件事是狗粪便如何成为武器。
“如果有人在街上遛狗，狗拉了屎，你可以等那个人用狗屎袋捡起狗屎，然后你就可以打那个人，让他们扔下装满狗屎的狗袋，然后你就可以把它捡起来扔给人们，”他说。
往人身上扔狗屎并不是一件好事，想必《GTA 6》类似《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》的新荣誉系统会让你为此感到震惊，或者至少我们希望如此。 GTA 6 还允许你抚摸狗或责骂它们，我们希望任何责骂好男孩的人也能获得荣誉。
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-28-at-12.03.00-PM.png
《GTA 6》将于 11 月 19 日在 PS5 和 Xbox Series X|S 上发布，它的上市背后有大量的炒作。 GTA 6 预计将售出数百万份 - 数量如此之多，仅预购就可以支付游戏的全部开发预算。

items.summary: Gallipoli is the most beautiful game in the WW1 series yet, with excellent maps, fun new classes, and a contin

others.title: Rockstar has to 'be careful' about what GTA 6 picks to satirize because 'very specific political issues or memes will date fast'

content.v: Well lads, we've done it. We've landed ashore and now it's time to rush forward into enemy territory for God and King. The rules of engagement are simple: there's only one rule, and that rule… is to have fun. And maybe make some friends along the way? BlackMill Games' Gallipoli, the fourth in its well-established WW1 series, is its best-looking and strongest WW1 project to date, and I'm ready to party like it's 1915. Not only is Gallipoli a step above its predecessors in terms of its graphics and gameplay, it does an exemplary job of conveying a sense of historical accuracy while remaining fun to play. So chaps, keep a stiff upper lip and let's charge into certain doom, shall we?

Gallipoli is set in the Middle Eastern front, the only World War 1 front not yet featured in one of BlackMill's games. For some historical context, the forces here are primarily the Ottoman Empire versus the British Empire, a lumbering old empire in its failing days versus an empire that was still the most powerful in the world. If you, like me, grew up in the good old US of A, you probably spent zero time in school learning anything about the Middle Eastern Front of World War 1, because America didn't do anything in that part of the world during that part of the first World War. In contrast, in Australia and New Zealand, the national day of remembrance established to acknowledge the tragedy of the Gallipoli campaign has completely usurped Remembrance Day in terms of national significance.

Since World War 1 is maybe the most impactful event in the history of humankind, it's a shame vast parts of it often go undiscussed. This is something that makes Gallipoli all the more appealing to me. I want to learn more about this part of history now. I would venture to say I'm a little more well-versed than most in World War 1 history, but I've only ever really studied the Western Front and its long lines of muddy, rat-infested trenches.

When I'm playing Gallipoli and I start into a map, like Anzac Cove (which also happens to be my favorite), I find myself compelled to learn more. The loading screens have brief snippets of historical context to read, which is great, although it's not enough to scratch the itch I have. It's just a beautiful outgrowth of an excellent game; to be such a compelling experience as a video game as to make me want to learn more about the actual history.
The Middle Eastern Front

If you're on the attacking side of the Anzac Cove map – that is, the British Empire – you start the match being rowed to shore in double-ender rowboats. We've all seen the scenes, both real and created by Hollywood, featuring the storming of Normandy during the Second World War. Anzac Cove is almost the same, but there are no diesel-powered landing craft opening their ramps into a hail of enemy bullets. Just Commonwealth troops scrambling out of painfully slow, wildly exposed wooden boats under a torrent of machine gun fire.

The uniforms at the start of World War 1 were basically just fancy clothes for army men; nothing like the armor and helmets of today. I love that Gallipoli captures the schism between the rapid advancement of warfighting technology and the lag that followed while armies had to figure out, in real time, how to fight this new and horrible type of war. Men were thrusting themselves into meat grinders, and the answer to the high casualty rates was simply "throw more men in." It's an era where the technology of war had fast outpaced the strategies to fight it.

For example, the machine gun. Gallipoli has two machine gunner classes: light, and the new heavy machine gunner class. While they have different abilities and missions, their ultimate goal is to spit out as much lead as is possible in the shortest amount of time. This will either provide cover for advancing troops or, in what I find to be one of the coolest additions to Gallipoli, terrify your opponents. In Gallipoli, you now get experience points for laying down suppressive fire, but that fire also has an effect on players.

During one match I found myself pinned down and separated from my squad, and the enemy team was laying down a constant barrage of fire in my direction. Suddenly, the terror of it all got to my character and I went into a panic mode. My vision was blurred. I couldn't maintain a steady aim down the sights of my rifle. In essence, I had lost my nerve, and that element of the gameplay ultimately caused me to take the L and have to respawn.

What a fantastic way to add another layer of realism. Does it suck when bullets are whizzing over your head and suddenly you lose your faculties? Yes, of course it does. But that's just an extra dimension to the experience, and one that I didn't think I'd appreciate as much as I do. And it goes both ways, too. You can panic oncoming troops and, while machine gunners have it easier by means of bullet volume, I was able to panic my enemies just by firing at them with my standard-issue rifle. On top of another wrinkle of realism, it also means shots that don't land on their intended targets can still provide a benefit to you and your team.
Class Actions

The machine gun wasn't entirely new by the time WW1 kicked off, but there hadn't been a test of it at scale to that point. At the start of the war, people basically had no idea how to approach them on the battlefield. Thanks to the suppression and panic systems, that feeling is replicated well here in Gallipoli. The heavy machine gunner is tasked with building machine guns wherever they can be built but, strategically speaking, you want to build them where they can help hold a line – or help advance your troops. It's so wonderful when you're laying down fire and suppressing the enemy and your team is able to break through and advance.

While the heavy machine gunner builds machine gun embankments, the light machine gunner brings his along for the ride. This is another thing I really like about Gallipoli; you can't John-Rambo your way through a map hip firing a light machine gun. That's Hollywood stuff. Unlike Call of Duty, or most modern first-person shooters, guns in Gallipoli behave like they would in real life. That means trying to hip fire your light machine gun is pointless. The barrel swings wildly and the shots are so scattered it doesn't even panic your opponents. In fact, it makes you a nice target instead. If you want to do well with the light machine gun, you’d better put your face in the dirt and lay down some covering fire for the fellas to make that final push.

Realism with guns and weapons is part of the experience. Rifles and pistols lose their effectiveness depending on range. Not all bullets are built equally, and a rifle that does well at mid or close range is basically useless at long range. Even if you do hit a target from across the field, depending on the gun, it might not stop them or even do much damage. Pistols, the weapons of the officer class, are a great example of this. With their short barrels and powerful kick, hitting a target at any sort of distance is a challenge both in the real world and in Gallipoli. If you're coming into this expecting the kind of gunplay in CoD or Battlefield, you're going to be pretty bummed out. I'm not disparaging those franchises, either (I love CoD multiplayer and review it every year for IGN), but Gallipoli is focused on realism more than dynamic, clippable action.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/28/gta-ps5-save-5-on-ultimate-edition-1787929501697.png
If you're already planning to spend $100 on the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition, I've spotted a pretty painless way to knock $5 off the price before you've even placed your preorder.

Amazon is currently selling a $100 PlayStation Store gift card for $95 for Prime members , giving you an instant $5 saving that you can put towards your GTA 6 preorder. It's not going to change your life, but if you're going to spend the money anyway, you may as well get $5 of it back.

The maths is particularly simple if you're planning to buy the $99.99 GTA 6 Ultimate Edition . Buy the gift card for $95, use that $100 of PlayStation Store credit to pay for the game, and you've effectively saved five bucks.

It's worth noting that this particular offer is for Prime members , so make sure you're signed into the right Amazon account before checking out. And, as ever with these gift card discounts, I'd recommend checking the final price at checkout before placing your order in case the promotion has changed.
GTA 6 Preorder Bonus
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/27/preorder-1787856382124.jpeg
All GTA 6 preorders come with the Vintage Vice City Pack, which includes a classic car, outfits and hairstyles for Jason and Lucia, and an exclusive weapon pattern.

Note that the Vintage Vice City Pack is included with all digital purchases of GTA 6 made before November 20, 2026, so you don't necessarily need to preorder today to get it.

What's Included With the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition?

The $99.99 Ultimate Edition includes the base game alongside a sizeable collection of additional digital content, with Rockstar describing the extras as being threaded throughout Jason and Lucia's story.

The Ultimate Edition also unlocks several special destinations, including Rideout Customs, Sara's Unisex Salon, Stock 305, Electric Fang Tattoo, and One-Eyed Willie's.

Whether all of that is worth the extra money over the standard edition is another question entirely. If you're primarily interested in playing GTA 6 itself, the standard edition will obviously get you the game.

But if you've already decided you're going all-in on the Ultimate Edition (like most people, I must say) , there's very little reason not to use the discounted $100 PlayStation Store gift card and keep that extra $5 in your pocket.

items.title: 刚刚，鹰角拿下了科隆游戏展最有专业性的大奖
items.summary: 在刚刚结束的科隆游戏 展大奖评选Gamescom Award上，鹰角获得了由 全球玩家和现场观众评选 而出的最佳展 台奖。 很大程度上来说，这恰恰是科隆游戏展所能颁出的最具专业性和公信力的奖项——已经成为全球头号游戏大展

content.v: 在刚刚结束的科隆游戏 展大奖评选Gamescom Award上，鹰角获得了由 全球玩家和现场观众评选 而出的最佳展 台奖。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14345/a9fe30cc9cf14e82b6b4c551c63712a8.appmsg_mw680water
很大程度上来说，这恰恰是科隆游戏展所能颁出的最具专业性和公信力的奖项——已经成为全球头号游戏大展的科隆游戏展，今年首次卖光了约23.3 万平方米的全部可用展区。超过1700家来自67个国家和地区的游戏厂商汇聚于此，尽其所能“争奇斗艳“，只为获得现场玩家们片刻的注意力。
能在科隆游戏展拿下“最佳展台奖”，基本也代表着成为了全世界最会设计和布置展台、最擅长在线下凝聚玩家的游戏厂商。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14345/40dcb5620ca7a58932227a08f4b2217a.appmsg_mw680water
赢下的对手们也不弱
同时这也是中国厂商首次获得该奖项 ——在此之前，该奖项都由知名的老牌大厂或IP获得。例如去年获得该奖项的是宝可梦公司（The Pokémon Company），再往前则是不计成本花重金包下一个展馆几乎一半场地的XBOX、更早两届则都是由非常擅长用热门动漫IP来制造大型奇观装置的万代南梦宫……
近年中国游戏和厂商在科隆游戏展上的存在感越来越强，到如今鹰角拿下该奖项，算是达到了又一个里程碑。
那么话说回来，带着《明日方舟：终末地》来参展的鹰角，究竟又是怎样从这样激烈的竞争里脱颖而出的？
其实在科隆游戏展开幕后的前两天里，国内不少玩家就已经在关注中国厂商在其中的表现。
鹰角当时就是最出圈的展台之一——因为当其他厂商都利用着自家寸土寸金买来的展区、密集地布置用于各种活动的区域时， 偏偏鹰角在从展会正门进入的第一个大馆8号馆内，包下了两个大展区，放置了三个巨大的雕像——即终末地里的三个Boss“聂菲斯”“三位一体”“阿莱克琉斯”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14345/ce802111e700b5a3dec9a716db752f80.appmsg_mw680water
相比其他每一寸空间都被塞得满满当当的展台，鹰角这边明显更强调布景之间的距离与整体空间感。
尤其醒目的是近乎对称的整体布局，加上覆盖展台顶部的大面积镜面结构，足以让每个走近展台的人产生一种空间被成倍放大的观感。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14345/4cb05cca3096c90f7ec173aaa4647fa3.appmsg_mw680water
这个设计也让不少 玩家 调侃，终末地制作人海猫这次算是彻底“摆爽了”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14345/81d2e7243910abb06dbcffccccf9d663.appmsg_mw680water
四 核 摆 完
海外玩家同样没见过这样的阵仗，对此也是大受震撼：
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14345/957f56d00d26b074f148013807ff46e7.appmsg_mw680water
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14345/42a295d5e2b1b046d3048f577f2a3674.appmsg_mw680water
玩笑归玩笑， 其实到了现场，很容易感受到这样的展位布置背后的实际用意。
像这样不惜成本的投入，确实让终末地展台在一众厂商之间显得格外独特：相比尽可能提高空间利用率，它更强调整体的视觉呈现，让玩家行走在其间更有沉浸感，并近距离看清这些Boss的设计究竟藏着多少细节。
就以摆放了雕像的这侧展台来说——静态陈列时，就看得出雕像的做工细腻到惊人。在特定时点，还会开启演出和灯光秀：雕像与身后的巨型LED屏幕、灯光及音效相互配合，进一步还原这些Boss在游戏中登场时的氛围。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14345/c5f02cd70cf28ad31878d3e3e69e3cf5.appmsg_mw680water
现场演出环节之外的静态陈列状态
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14345/70355c8667279bf01cc4e0713167f208.appmsg_mw680water
Boss灯光秀环节的屏幕配合
但之所以留出那么大 片的 区域，除了观赏用途，还有一个目的就是 用于让现场玩家留影。
正因为场地留得足够宽敞，才让玩家能够和这些布景完整同屏，密集的观众人群也不会闯入镜头。同时， 现场也有 专门的摄影师在设置好的最佳机位来帮玩家拍照，确保出片效果。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14345/fa34280edeaa0165bc2e8bfbc140d3f3.appmsg_mw680water
当然，玩家也可以选择进场用自己的设备自选角度拍摄
这在今年整个科隆展现场确实是独一份的体验。
大家应该也不难想象：现场通过各种大型奇观装置来吸引玩家注意力的展台并不少，例如终末地对面就是CDPR为《巫师3：狂猎 重制版》和新DLC布置的展台，带来的雕像和布景同样非常细腻。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14345/109246395ca6376dec09fc5e598231f2.appmsg_mw680water
但大部分展台的布置理念，大多停留在了“让玩家们在远处就能看到、吸引他们过来”，像《巫师3》能在展台奇观前留出一小块合照区域也已经算得上非常细心——但玩家们还是很难找到一个角度把自己和吸引自己而来布景都拍到镜头中，更别说抓一个没有其他路人入镜的瞬间。
终末地的展台则真正将这一点做成了一种体验，或者说是“内容”。
路过的观众可以直接在展台外围自行取景，而愿意排队的人，则可以接受官方摄影师的引导，在预先设置好的机位完成一套更完整的拍摄体验。尽管逐一取景、拍摄显然需要更长时间的等待，但现场依旧排起了长长的队伍，站在人流中，你能听到队列中的玩家相互搭话，聊起了终末地的游戏内容，氛围堪称迷你嘉年华。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14345/eefc3f20c6f8777d8729073c1091b318.appmsg_mw680water
相比之下，另一边同样留出了大块空地的展区 ， 就采用了更加开放的互动形式： 游客们可以自由走入其中，舞台上有对应游戏中角色的COSER们轮番登台，还 会主动引导观众们走近一些来互动和留影。
对比许多游戏展台，选择把COS舞台设置在展区边缘，或是直接让COSER站在外沿拉拢人气，却让汇聚过来的玩家们只能和路过的人流挤在一起——鹰角能像这样自己买下展区腾出大块自留空间，带给现场玩家们的体验感自然好不少。
做出这样的设计和效果 或许 并不需要什么惊天的创意， 却需要审美和为玩家考虑的用心。走到这里也不难理解 ，为什么各国玩家们体验过之后，会愿意给出一票，将其选为最佳展台。
事 实上，鹰角在科隆现场布置的也不止是网上传播最广的广阔展台以及巨大雕像。在两个展区的背面 ， 一层 还有着面积不小的试玩区和终末地周边贩售区 ，排的玩家队伍也更长。
正面展台的三座雕像，实际也对应着这次现场可挑战速通的三场Boss战。有屏幕实时显示现场玩家们留下的记录。
舞台区的竞速挑战赛
试玩区的竞速排名
相比于其他动作类游戏的试玩区，能看到终末地这边明显有更多女性玩家参与其中。
我在现场遇见了一名身穿自制COS服的海外玩家——他手里拎着参与互动和采购而来的大包小包终末地周边，还在和展台工作人员逐一确认自己有没有漏了什么活动。
我问他这套行头准备了多久，他回答说做了足足两个月，紧接着又用说悄悄话的姿态讲道：“你知道的，其实不应该花这么久。但又要上班又要打游戏，能抽空的时间实在太少了……”
他说自己喜欢终末地里的所有内容——如果一定要选个“最”的话，那就是角色故事更吸引他。而这次终末地的展台，则是更加彻底的“每一个部分”，分不出任何先后。
他当然不是唯一自己穿着COS服来终末地展台的玩家。我遇到的另一位玩家光是在制作武器上就花了40个小时。
他说自己更喜欢游戏里的工厂建设部分——唯独说到这一点时， 这位玩家的表情略显遗憾，或许他还想再见到终末地去年参展时带来的集成工业设施。
不过今年的展台，也设计了相应的互动玩法上来弥补这一部分的遗憾。现场有一个互动环节，是玩家可以从不断滚动的工厂流水线上选取一个盲盒开出奖品——从创新性和对于游戏设定的融合角度来说都不错。
今年是我连续第三年来到科隆游戏展，也恰好见证了鹰角三次带着终末地参展。
第一年，鹰角的展台还位于地下的10.2馆，和诸多独立游戏与外设厂商挤在一起。一些外国玩家会兴冲冲地跑过来说”明日方舟！”随即又带着疑惑问道：“什么是终末地？”
去年鹰角则是已经入驻了8号馆，布置了上文提到的集成工业设施，安排了好几排的试玩机器——气氛很热闹，但 那会儿 游戏还没正式上线，能有多少人转换为真实的玩家？谁心里也没数。
现在，正如玩家们嘴上会调侃“鹰角你这样愣摆三个‘大模型’，是真不拉新了吗！”，实际也都知道，这意味着终末地上线以来，在海外的成绩和知名度都足以去支撑这样看似“无欲无求”的布展风格。

items.title: 一家动画公司的“大力飞砖”，砸出了一款不一样的二游
items.summary: 如果说有什么作品能代表艺画开天，《灵笼》大概是最绕不开的一个名字。 2019年，当国产3D动画仍大量扎堆仙侠、玄幻题材时，《灵笼》凭借末世科幻世界观、极具辨识度的场景设计和冲击力十足的演出，成为了近年来最热门的国产动画之

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14343/3607e87b62f07eb97ae5a353e5252c9f.appmsg_mw680water
如果说有什么作品能代表艺画开天，《灵笼》大概是最绕不开的一个名字。
2019年，当国产3D动画仍大量扎堆仙侠、玄幻题材时，《灵笼》凭借末世科幻世界观、极具辨识度的场景设计和冲击力十足的演出，成为了近年来最热门的国产动画之一。甚至甚至直到现在，《灵笼》依然是很多观众念念不忘、反复提起的一部作品。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14343/f42f3fa1d9f50dc0b933aa062141117e.appmsg_mw680water
《灵笼》剧照
也因此，当艺画开天公布《凡应》游戏首支预告片，宣布进军游戏领域时，不少玩家都好奇这样一家动画公司究竟能做出怎样的东西？
从我最初知道《凡应》这个项目到现在，已经有三年多时间。期间，我关注了它公开的每支PV，也参与了每轮测试。这个过程中，项目并非一路顺利，经历过方向调整，也曾一度推倒重来。在艺画开天的官方账号中，还能看到一支调侃这段经历的视频。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14343/aefcd8d075c8b7fce94a9659c5f653c8.gif_mw680
而在今天，经历过一次“重生”的《凡应》正式开启了第二次测试。
实际体验下来，我最大的感受是，艺画开天确实把一家动画公司最难被复制的看家本事，全都塞进了《凡应》里——从高规格的演出制作，到细致的角色塑造与镜头表达，来自动画公司的创作基因，使这款游戏呈现出一种和市面上大多数二游完全不同的气质。
先说最直观的部分，《凡应》是一款“长板长得出奇“的作品。
进入游戏，首先能感受到的，就是项目在美术和演出上的高投入。
在《凡应》的设定中，故事发生在一片不断奔流的白色沙海——“净海”之上，人们乘着 “海巡兽”在沙海穿行，终日生活在一种名为“隆舶”的巨大生物之上。但游戏游戏对这片沙海的呈现，并没有走常见的荒漠路线。
相反，游戏中少见的陆地上，场景都做得相当绚烂，使用了大量在二游中不那么常见的高饱和色、复杂的植被与环境结构叠在一起，却没有显得杂乱，整体看上出画面非常饱满，又颇具冲击力。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14343/197f1cd7397b6bd023e62e9c4c25ffa6.appmsg_mw680water
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14343/b8fbdf9bc860a2cea44235cab0a27c27.appmsg_mw680water
而净海之上，沙体混杂着彩色的颗粒，在流动和光照下会泛起不同颜色的光泽，经过碰撞，表面会泛起诡异的紫色波纹，场景和特效都不避讳鲜艳而强烈的颜色，但碰撞在一起却又形成了一种相当和谐、幻想味十足的效果。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14343/225ae45d02379323ad7f92af1019a2f5.appmsg_mw680water
而在剧情演出上，你很难想象，仅游戏第一章中，就有数十分钟的高质量过场动画。且这些过长动画大多场景规模宏大，人物动作、镜头调度极具冲击力，单拎出来看，已经不输近几年顶尖的国产动画电影。
当然，用文字来描述画面，怎么说都显得有些苍白。所以我们不如直接多放几张动图在这里，大家先自己感受一下《凡应》的视觉表现力：
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14343/dc0cd4f1c7e481431f09b6c746e25f96.gif_mw680
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14343/1a9a4410c219541398508c33bc683d8b.gif_mw680
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14343/5bc692b525609e35182c67adee0885f0.gif_mw680
其中，让我印象深刻的是第一次进入“与狭间”的演出——按照设定，这里是不同世界彼此交汇的地方，而对玩家来说，它同时也是游戏中抽卡的地方。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14343/b0d9fe95e7e6e5d29a876a68fc7286d0.appmsg_mw680water
但和大多游戏不同，《凡应》没有用一段“点这里、然后再点那里”的新手教程，把玩家送进抽卡界面，而是专门做了一整段跨越两个世界的演出。这段演出的表现力颇高，等我从“与狭间”出来时，也真的产生了一种在危急关头，从另一个世界带回援军的感觉。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14343/a5e1ba0961b96cf386517ccc097de0f0.gif_mw680
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14343/fb74131f11c9621d316110beab4046ad.gif_mw680
而这种高规格的视觉投入，也并不只体现在这些大场面、重要剧情CG里。让我比较惊讶的是，在最常规的抽卡界面，凡应甚至为当期UP角色制作了一段单独的人物PV。这样的投入规格，在目前的二游里还是独一份的存在。
谁见过进卡池先放一段动画啊
而在《凡应》里，诸如此类会让人不禁感叹“原来这里也能加一段动画啊”的地方其实还有不少，总体玩下来，这游戏很容易让人产生一种演出“大力飞砖”的感觉。
但比起单纯说这是堆料，我认为《凡应》当前呈现出的状态，一定程度上正是上文提到的“动画公司的创作基因”在起作用。
这里的所谓“创作基因”，并不只是说艺画开天更会做动画演出、高规格CG，而是指，它似乎更习惯用动画的方式去思考游戏中很多原本偏功能性的东西。
一个直观的例子是，上文提到的《凡应》第一次把玩家带进“与狭间”时的演出。
想象一下，很多游戏处理抽卡系统时，可能只需要玩家升到某个等级，或推进到某个节点之后，通过一段系统提示解锁；但大多数影视作品在塑造主角能力觉醒时，都会将其放在孤立无援、局势最危急的节点，再通过获得新的力量或援军登场完成情绪上的释放。
《凡应》处理抽卡系统时，用的就是这样的思路。
这样处理的好处，不仅是让玩家在第一次接触它时，实实在在收获了一场试听上的高潮。更重要的是，原本再普通不过的抽卡，被自然嵌进了故事里，玩家第一次接触它时，就通过演出理解了它和世界观之间的关系，后续再展开更深层的设定和用途，也会显得顺理成章。
显然，《凡应》中的狭间也的确还有着更深一层的设定
而“与狭间”只是其中一个比较典型的例子，动画创作思维给《凡应》带来的优势，其实远不止这些。
《凡应》的舞台建立在“净海”之上，其中有“海巡兽”“隆舶”各种生物，这个世界有不同的势力，很多设定听起来都不算常见，如果依靠文本堆砌，很容易变成常规二游中一连串晦涩的名词。
但《凡应》更倾向于把这些东西演给玩家看。
像是建筑的窗户会不断涌进细沙、NPC会佩戴面罩……这些细节也会反复提醒玩家，这里的人究竟生活在一个怎样的世界，很多设定甚至不需要专门解释，游戏就已经通过画面，把这个世界的模样塞进了玩家脑袋中。
而在世界观设定之下，也能看到《凡应》在玩法上所展现的一些新鲜的东西。
比如，人们乘坐的海巡兽并不只是故事里的背景板，它承担着串联不同陆地和区域的作用，玩家可以亲自驾驶海巡兽穿行于净海之上，体验海上探索与战斗；不同角色也会通过各自的能力，为海巡兽提供不同的属性加成，多少有些“二次元黑旗”的味道。
海巡兽操作起来有种Q弹的感觉，手感很舒适
在这样一个有着各种奇观的末世里，玩家也并不总是在战斗和漂泊，隆舶上有着属于自己的一方天地，可以布置家园、和角色相处，这些相对慢节奏的内容又为末世增添了几分难得的温馨感。
而经过几轮迭代，如今《凡应》的战斗部分也已经不再是明显的短板。部分角色的动作设计相当出彩，招式衔接干脆，打击反馈扎实，整体已经算得上同类产品里的较高的水准。
“叮——“的声音也很悦耳
这些内容单拿出来或许算不上特别突出的亮点，但被动画叙事思路以及高规格演出串联到一起，整体体验就有了明显不同。至少在我自己的体验中，会忍不住想继续玩下去，看看下一个场景是什么样，也想知道这个世界还会发生什么。
这或许也是《凡应》最特别的地方——相比调一家动画公司有多会做CG，它更重要的意义在于，为二游赛道带来了一套不一样的叙事和演出思路。
其实回顾游戏行业的发展，以演出见长的作品从来不少。早一些时候有几乎挽救了史克威尔命运的《最终幻想》系列，近些年也有《尼尔》这样的作品，游戏借助演出强化叙事与情绪，本身并不是什么新鲜事。
但另一方面，近年国内二游的制作标准不断上抬，角色建模越来越精细，电影化演出、大量CG几乎已经成了头部项目的常见配置。但当高规格制作变成一种“标配”之后，真正能够给玩家留下印象、被玩家记住的作品，反而并没有想象中那么多——甚至在另一边，“能不能跳剧情”反而成了二游社区反复出现的争议。
原因并不复杂。
能够依靠演出打动玩家的作品，本身就很难被简单复制。一方面，高规格CG和大量演出意味着实打实的制作成本；另一方面，叙事节奏、镜头组织、情绪铺垫……这些东西既难量化，也很难靠模仿照搬。
而相比“在游戏里插入很多动画”，《凡应》做的更像是在把将原本属于动画创作的思考方式带进了游戏里。从目前展现出来的内容看，它也的确建立了一套属于自己的视觉风格和叙事语言。
当然，《凡应》的做法最终能不能长久地持续下去，现在依然很难下结论。高密度、高规格的演出意味着不低的长期制作成本和制作周期，对于一款需要持续运营的二游来说，如何让项目平稳地运营下去，也是它接下来亟需回答的问题。
但相比这款产品最终能够走多远，我想《凡应》更重要的意义在于，它至少提供了一种不同的内容生产思路。
